body: WHEREAS, the Minnesota Indian Affairs Council Membership consists of representatives of 10 of the 11 federally-recognized Indian Tribes located within the State of Minnesota, members of the legislature, commissioners from the state department, and
WHEREAS, the Minnesota Indian Affairs Council is a liaison between the state and local units of government in the delivery of services to American Indians in the State of Minnesota, and
